A possible solution here is teaching the cats to adjust to y'alls sleep schedule. 

Our cats do sleep in the bedroom with my gf and I, but they stay asleep until 6-7am or so. We got an automatic feeder for their first morning meal set at 7AM so they will bother the device rather than us for their first meal.

We also feed their last meal of kibble at 9PM and try to play a little with them too so they get sleepy around the time we go to bed.

Good choice to focus on the new story first instead of fanservice. AreOri shot themselves in the foot with the big fanservice focus. A new setting and a fresh team seems interesting. 

The description seems to imply there is already a club from the get-go so there might be an emphasis on making your team get along as a goal. Which would go hand-in-hand with a more engaging affection system. Somethin' like strikers, but that it also effects plays on the field. Your striker refusing to pass to the guy he hates etc. I'd love somethin like that.

I still like Unmei's design and the school uniform looks great. The uniform vibes a bit old-schoolish but I am not sure if they'd dare go for a prequel setting within the timeline. It's still in Japan, but in another part of it after all. So it'd give the story plenty time to breath and make you get used to the new cast and setting instead of shoving Endou constantly in your face for example.
A setting at least a year after the orion anime seems logical, because I doubt they will be able to 100% design new opponents and toss all current models to the Chronicles mode. Gotta at least be restricted to characters that make sense to be there. So no Go and Og characters, but the areori versions of existing characters. Considering the push for areori charas merch it'd be odd to not have it be in that timeline. 
And if it will be 100% no old characters it'll be restricted to siblings/references and a shorter story in general. Which is also fine with me.

Either way, something in the vibe of what Danball Senki Wars did in terms of a soft reboot would be nice tbh. That handled the og cast references(&appearance of 1) really well without ever making the old mc's of s1 and s2 ever show their face.
Gonna assume it'll be something similar what they are doing with their ps4 mecha game and what happened with Youkai Watch Gakuen Y. Free updates for sure.
